title: SMS Messaging Consent & Opt-In
subtitle: Central Reform Congregation — CRC Music
highlight.heading: How SMS Opt-In Works
highlight.intro: CRC Music musicians may opt in to receive SMS scheduling notifications by providing their phone number and enabling SMS notifications in their profile settings within the CRC Music application.
highlight.optInVoluntary: Opt-in is {term1} and {term2} to use the CRC Music application. Musicians can use email and in-app notifications instead.
programDescription.heading: Program Description
programDescription.operatorAndPurpose: Central Reform Congregation operates the CRC Music application, which includes an optional SMS notification service for musician scheduling. When musicians opt in, they receive text messages about:
programDescription.schedulingAssignments: {term} Notification when you're assigned to play at a service
programDescription.reminders: {term} Service reminders 48 hours before your scheduled performance
programDescription.confirmations: {term} Confirmation when you accept or decline an assignment
programDescription.cancellations: {term} Notification if a service or your assignment is cancelled
programDescription.scheduleChanges: {term} Updates to services you're assigned to
consentProcess.heading: Consent Process
consentProcess.musiciansProvideConsent: Musicians provide consent to receive SMS messages through the following process:
consentProcess.signCrcMusic: Sign in to the CRC Music application at {link}
consentProcess.enterPhoneNumber: Enter your phone number in the Phone Number field
consentProcess.toggleNotificationSwitch: Toggle the {term} notification switch to ON
consentProcess.completingTheseSteps: By completing these steps, the musician affirmatively consents to receive SMS messages from CRC Music at the phone number provided.
messageFrequency.heading: Message Frequency
messageFrequency.messageFrequencyVaries: Message frequency varies based on how often the musician is scheduled for services. Typical musicians receive 2-8 messages per month. Messages are only sent in relation to your specific scheduling activity.
messageDataRates.heading: Message and Data Rates
messageDataRates.standardMessageData: Standard message and data rates may apply depending on your mobile carrier and plan. CRC does not charge for SMS messages sent through the Service.
optOut.heading: Opt-Out
optOut.optOutSms: You may opt out of SMS messages at any time by:
optOut.replyingMessageReceived: Replying {term} to any message received from CRC Music
optOut.disablingSmsToggle: Disabling the SMS toggle in your CRC Music profile settings
optOut.removingPhoneNumber: Removing your phone number from your profile settings
optOut.afterOptingOut: After opting out, you will receive one final confirmation message. You will no longer receive SMS messages from CRC Music unless you opt in again.
help.heading: Help
help.helpSmsNotifications: For help with SMS notifications, reply {term} to any message or contact us at {link}.
dataPrivacy.heading: Data Privacy
dataPrivacy.mobileInformationIncluding: Mobile information, including phone numbers, will not be shared with third parties for marketing or promotional purposes.
dataPrivacy.phoneNumbersStored: Phone numbers are stored securely and used solely for delivering scheduling-related SMS messages through our messaging provider (Twilio). See our full {link} for details on how we handle your data.
